Everything it knows

Eight quiet abilities.

Bloop is a working prototype. These are the features we are building, and your answers decide which ones come first.

Live GPS

See where your dog is on a map, anywhere there is 4G. No phone on the dog needed.

Sleep

How long your dog slept and how restful the night was, day after day.

Steps

Daily steps and distance, with a goal that fits your dog's size and age.

Calories

Calories burned each day, so food and exercise stay in balance.

Activity

Resting, walking, running or playing, told apart automatically through the day.

Night light

A built-in light so drivers, cyclists and you can see your dog after dark.

Fully waterproof

Monsoon walks, bath time, a swim in the lake. Designed to take all of it.

Your dog's data

Every walk, nap and trend is saved for you: a long-term record of your dog's life.

Intelligence

It learns your dog. Then it looks out for them.

AI Vet Connect

Bloop keeps your dog's history, then the AI studies it: sleep, activity, steps and calories over weeks. It points out changes worth a closer look and prepares a clear summary you can share with your vet.

AI Pet Avatar

Your dog as a living avatar in the app. It shows how active, rested or tired your dog was today, and tells the day's story in a few friendly lines.

Made for real dog days

Evening walks, lake swims, long naps.

How it works

Put it on. Open the app. That is all.

Clip it on

GPS, a 4G connection, a motion sensor and a light, all in one pod. Charge it, then clip it on like any collar.

It tracks quietly

Location, steps, activity and sleep are recorded all day and sent to the cloud over 4G.

The AI explains

The app shows the day at a glance. The AI Pet Avatar tells you the story, and AI Vet Connect watches the long-term pattern.

A 4-layer board, about 58 × 30 mm, small enough to disappear into the pod. The image is the layout of the real board we are manufacturing.
